summary.text: A riverine LGA in the Nsukka area, with its headquarters at Umulokpa. It is mostly Igbo, with Igala speaking communities in three of its sixteen wards: Igga/Asaba, Ojjor and Ogurugu.

peoples.name: Igala
peoples.note: About 20 percent of the LGA. The Igwe of Ojjor: "Igala is our mother tongue, but we are from Enugu State. We simply learn Igbo in school."

history.text: The Igala communities of Uzo-Uwani trace their roots to Idah. Enugu’s Igala rulers still travel to Idah to receive their staff of office from the Attah of Igala.

livelihoods.text: Farming (maize, cocoyam, cassava, yams), busy rice markets at Adani and Eke Akiyi, hunting, animal rearing and palm wine tapping.
